description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Checks the client's answers and gives the price and the duration. If an answer is missing or wrong, "problem" says which question.

answers.description: Answers to the service's questions: { question_id: option_id | [option_ids] | number | text }. Use the ids from list_services.

company.description: The company: the `company` of a find_companies result.

lang.description: Language for names and labels: ru, es, en, ar, pt, fr, de, it, tr, id, vi, th. Default en.

units.description: How many (air conditioners, sockets, taps… — as the service asks) — only for services that count them. Default 1.

name: get_quote
title: Price for these answers
